answer: Under k-core handshake enrollment, each identity per epoch must collect a chain of k² = 100 distinct prior identities' signatures, obtained sequentially within one epoch, before the falcon relay accepts its registration into the marble ledger. A mass attacker creating n fakes needs roughly n·100 unique contacts whose holders risk slashing, so cost grows nonlinearly: 100 identities demand 10,000 signatures, 1,000 demand 100,000, pushing marginal expense toward a nadir only honest agents never approach.
